text:
morgan: Quick postmortem follow-up: we've seen repeating KV eviction spikes that look like the same pattern. I'd like runbook edits + an automated detector that flags recurring patterns and creates follow-ups. Can volunteers take runbook, triage commands, and automation?
incident-bot: PM report: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-kv-eviction-repeaters  raw traces + alert history attached.
sam: I can own the runbook text and make it ML-friendly (clear steps + one-line commands). Lia or Owen want to own triage snippets?
lia: I'll take triage snippets. I'll make them minimal so on-call can copy/paste. Draft: 
```
# KV eviction quick triage (0-12m)
1) pod health: kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide
2) quick logs: kubectl logs -l app=runtime -n inference --tail 120 | egrep -i "evict|kv_cache|OOM"
3) metric snapshot: curl -fsS http://monitoring.internal/api/metrics?svc=runtime | jq '.kv_cache.evictions, .mem.rss'
4) if evictions > 40/min -> patch batch_size=1 + restart gateway:
   kubectl patch configmap rt-config -n inference --type merge -p '{"data":{"batch_size":"1"}}'
   kubectl rollout restart deployment/rt-gateway -n inference
5) request KV dump if repeating: curl -u svc-sre:REDACTED -X POST http://rt-admin.internal/dump_kv | gzip -c > kv_dump.gz
6) post-restart warmup: curl -sS http://rt-gateway.internal/healthz && echo '{"prompt":"warmup"}' | http POST http://rt-gateway.internal/v1/generate
7) escalate timeline: page @oncall at 10m, @runtime-leads at 25m, @dedicated-esc immediately for Dedicated tenants
```
owen: I'll add a tiny smoke script and a one-liner healthcheck for the runbook. I'll push gist and link in PR.
khi: For automation, I can prototype a recurring detector: small job that computes eviction-rate per hour and flags 3+ spikes in 24h, then auto-creates INC and posts to this thread. Proposed follow-ups: runbook update (sam) - INC-8410 - due 2026-04-12; triage snippets + smoke script (lia+owen) - INC-8411 - due 2026-04-08; automation detector (khi) - INC-8412 - due 2026-04-15.
morgan: Good breakdown. Please add exact paging text in the playbook (who to page + contact matrix) and include Dedicated CCs. Also include 'how to revert' steps if the batch tweak causes functional regressions.
sam: Will add revert guidance: revert configmap to last-good key and roll restart gateway. I'll open PR to docs/runbooks/kv-evictions.md and tag reviewers. Target PR by 2026-04-10.
lia: Gist with commands + smoke script: https://gist.internal/kv-evict-triage (will include exit codes 0/1/2).
owen: Gist with warmup script: https://gist.internal/kv-warmup-check (exits non-zero on failure).
khi: Automation plan: one-off lambda job that queries metrics, applies thresholds, and when threshold met creates INC and posts summary + sample traces to incident channel. I'll include a dry-run flag and a runbook link in the ticket. Prototype PR by 2026-04-15.
morgan: I'll create the tracking issue and wire these INC numbers into the postmortem follow-up doc. Once PRs merge and INCs close, I'll mark this follow-up resolved. Thanks all :thumbsup:
